2026-08-09 (issue #151): added 105016__julien-matthey__jm-fx-fireball-01-trimmed.wav, a
derivative of the file above (Art Sourcing Contract step 3 -- recombine/derive an
already-sourced CC0 asset, not a new download). The original ran 1.962s; the trimmed copy
cuts at 1.05s (keeps the attack/punch through its main decay hump, fades the last 60ms to
zero to avoid a click) and drops the long reverb tail that made the cast read as sluggish.
Same CC0 license applies to the derivative -- CC0 permits unrestricted derivative works.
Original file kept alongside, untouched, as provenance.

2026-08-11 (issue #111): added 105016__julien-matthey__jm-fx-fireball-01-normalized.wav, a
derivative of the -trimmed file above (Art Sourcing Contract step 3, same as the 2026-08-09
entry -- derived from an already-approved CC0 asset, not a new download). RMS-normalized to
-16 dBFS (from -13.53 dBFS) and length-fit to a common 1.20s target shared by all 4 per-element
cast files (from 1.050s -- padded with a 60ms-fade-then-silence tail, no trim needed). Same CC0
license applies. Both earlier files kept alongside, untouched, as provenance. See
docs/agents/tilesmith/log.md's 2026-08-11 entry for the full before/after measurement table.
